title: Venus in your left ear. The Moon in your right

lines.text: venus in your left ear. the moon in your right.
your venus is how you love
your moon is what you need
most of us only date with one of them
that soft wobble in the middle of your head is them meeting
align reads both before you see a face

cta.sub: for the ten-minute version + what your venus and moon need

caption:
Venus in your left ear, the Moon in your right 🎧 Headphones on, both ears.

Venus 221.23 Hz (one Venus year, raised 32 octaves) · Moon 210.42 Hz (one moon, new to new, raised 29 octaves)

They're 10.81 Hz apart. Your brain hears that difference as a slow wobble in the middle of your head: a binaural beat, right in the alpha range.

Your Venus is how you love. Your Moon is what you need to feel safe. Most of us only date with one of them.
